title: Offline Corpus Field Guide
text: Offline research requires a pinned corpus snapshot and a checksum manifest. The 2026 field guide records a retrieval recall target of 0.80 for English. Local indexes must preserve page anchors and source identity.

title: Seagrass Survey Methods
text: The 2025 survey covered 12 transects in Las Piñas. Two observers recorded 18 seagrass shoots per square metre. The protocol requires human review before publication.

title: Seagrass Survey Correction
text: The corrected 2025 survey covered 14 transects in Las Piñas. Two observers recorded 18 seagrass shoots per square metre. The earlier report of 12 transects is superseded.

title: Guia de investigacion sin conexion
text: La investigacion sin conexion requiere un indice local y un registro de procedencia. La traduccion debe conservar cifras y marcadores como {NAME}. El corpus necesita un checksum manifest.

title: Gabay sa pananaliksik na offline
text: Ang offline na pananaliksik ay nangangailangan ng lokal na indeks at talaan ng pinagmulan. Dapat panatilihin ng pagsasalin ang mga numero at placeholder {NAME}. Kailangan ang human review.
